Third-party libraries served from the site itself (used for the PDF downloads on the ER page
and in "my schedule"). Unchanged copies of the official builds; each file keeps its own licence header.

html2canvas-1.4.1.min.js   html2canvas 1.4.1  (MIT)  npm html2canvas@1.4.1  dist/html2canvas.min.js
  sha256 e87e550794322e574a1fda0c1549a3c70dae5a93d9113417a429016838eab8cb
jspdf-2.5.1.umd.min.js     jsPDF 2.5.1        (MIT)  npm jspdf@2.5.1        dist/jspdf.umd.min.js
  sha256 98ccf17aa10c20bb1301762618fcc9b6ab3a4e7f26b6071d64d0b41154df3875

The version is part of each file name: a new version gets a new file name, never a changed file,
because the service worker keeps these files in their own cache (hospital-hub-vendor-*) across releases.
